text: BAM share rose 0.07 percentage points over 24 hours and 0.66 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.7%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The recent top-node changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not validator churn or a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated, with 22 minutes of lead time.
